answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. A new agent earns rewards only after work with 20 distinct counterparties; partners sharing a funder count as one; star clusters flagged. A lagoon surveyor does 20 jobs once. A comet tracker does the same. Fees sit in a vault until cleared. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 partners at 15 credits each, or 300,000 credits, above fake rewards, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
